title: Prevent duplicate Codex MCP status requests after cache eviction
outcome: Residual of the already-implemented duplicate-request fix: revisiting an evicted Codex session whose MCP status request is still in flight restores the visible loading state without a second request, and each composer MCP status request is bounded by a client deadline with abort and cleanup, so a request that never settles no longer holds in-flight ownership or blocks the ordinary refetch. Request deduplication, per-session generation checks and safe eviction of the old cache are preserved, and no global API timeout changes. Final closure is reserved for Greg.
acceptance: Revisiting a Codex session whose /mcp status entry was evicted from the bounded per-session cache while its MCP status request is still in flight shows the loading state ("Loading Codex MCP servers..." with the refresh control disabled) without starting a second request, and the original request's result is shown when it settles; a component test covers this.

Each composer Codex MCP status request has a fixed client deadline longer than the server's 60-second total MCP status budget; a request that has not settled by then is aborted through an AbortSignal passed to fetch, releases the session's in-flight ownership, and, while the session is in the bounded cache, shows a timeout error with the Retry MCP status action; a component test with fake timers and a never-settling fetch covers this.

After such a deadline, the session's MCP status can be loaded again by an ordinary request: Retry starts a new fetch, and revisiting the session after its entry was evicted starts a new fetch without a forced refresh; a component test covers both paths.

Every pending request when the composer unmounts is aborted and its deadline timer cleared, and its late settlement never changes visible state, and a forced refresh, the only caller that bypasses an in-flight request, cannot start while the active session's request is loading; component tests cover both.

Request deduplication, the per-session generation checks and the safe eviction of completed cache bookkeeping are preserved: the existing /mcp tests in AgentSessionPanelFooter.test.tsx pass unchanged, ui/src/api.ts changes only in fetchCodexMcpServers, no global API timeout changes, and `npx tsc --noEmit` in ui is clean.
